1. **PDP8 dynamics**: PDP8 (May 2023) dramatically reshaped Vietnam's thermal pipeline — cancelling ~12 GW of planned coal and adding ~22+ GW of LNG-to-power. Many LNG projects remain in early planning with no FID.

3. **Captive power plants** at industrial complexes (Formosa, Hoa Phat, Lee & Man, etc.) are partially included; many smaller captive units (<30 MW) are excluded.

4. **Status is fluid**: Several "Planned/Approved" LNG projects face delays due to unresolved gas purchase agreements, tariff negotiations, and regulatory uncertainty. The Long Phu 1 coal project remains in legal/contractual limbo.

5. **Retired/decommissioned small units** at older plants (Uong Bi, Ninh Binh, Thu Duc) are not individually listed if below 30 MW.
